text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened during an outing with Aston 
Machan—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Phew, it's a bit early to head home, isn't 
it~? What should we do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When asked what we should do, what came to 
mind was the "Mascot Research" we did at 
the aquarium before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I was just helping out with her 
research, but... maybe there's something 
else I can do to assist...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see, hmm. Making good use of time and 
full of motivation. I think that's 
fantastic.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Look! It's the amusement park's mascot and 
absolute monarch: Carrot Queen!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Number one in both popularity and merch in 
the park. It has undeniably great design, 
with cute yet elegant movements...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you're so cute, you could make even 
Chan-chan go all soft and mushy...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh, you have an eye for quality.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let us charge in as well. Under 
the guise of observing, into the greeting 
queue...!

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Did everyone enjoy the story of the 
stars? Look up at the night sky and try 
talking to the stars, okay!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is Hoshimi-chan, the planetarium's 
pride and joy. I think her intellectual 
aura is quite splendid.
choice_data_list: I'll go ask right away if we can talk!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah... That's true.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"This zoo has a lot of mascots too, after 
all~. Pandas, okapis, and then..."

text_block_list.name: Zookeeper
text_block_list.text:
We're handing out numbered tickets for the 
petting zoo area! If you'd like to enter, 
please line up here!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I grabbed a numbered ticket and came back. 
However, Aston Machan was nowhere to be 
seen...

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
"Mommy! Ehehe, look! There's an Umamusume 
big sis mixed in with the goats!"

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, hehe. They're marching right along 
together~.

text_block_list.name: Goat
text_block_list.text: "Baaaaaaah... Maaaaaaah..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turning toward the voice, I see Aston 
Machan pouting among a herd of goats on a 
walk through the park.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ……Baaah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We took a break for now, but Aston Machan 
has been awfully quiet for a while. I 
apologized for getting separated, but...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to apologize. Machan was 
the one who took action, after all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...More to the point, that's not what I'm 
talking about.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...You haven't forgotten about Machan, 
have you?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's great that you're so devoted to 
mascot research. However, the number one 
mascot you need to keep your eyes on is—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Could that be... Chan?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I may have lost sight of what was 
truly important. In my eagerness to help 
with the research, I took my eyes off 
Aston Machan herself."
choice_data_list:
I'll keep a much closer eye on you from 
now on!

I'll make the most of today's 
reflections...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Of course! But since you seem to remember 
now, I won't hold it against you."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Setting that aside. Those grilled 
carrots over there look delicious."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back. Now then, please take a cute 
photo of this carrot and Curren-chan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Make sure you capture me properly in 
the lens, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan smiled brightly, carrot in 
hand. That sight was firmly etched into my 
own lens as well.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that's an admirable attitude. Still, 
getting too down on yourself isn't good 
either...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Machan was in the wrong too. So, shall 
we have a reflection meeting?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's eat something delicious and have a 
post-match review... Or rather, a strategy 
meeting!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of us chatted at a cafe 
about future plans. The awkwardness 
gradually faded, and we had a fulfilling 
time.
